q: Broad Peak, recently seen in the news due to an avalanche, is located in which mountain range?
explanation: Broad Peak is located in the Karakoram Range on the Pakistan-China border. It is the world's 12th-highest mountain.

q: Broad Peak is the world's ______ highest mountain.
explanation: Broad Peak stands at an elevation of 8,051 meters and is the 12th-highest mountain in the world.

q: Broad Peak is locally known as
explanation: Broad Peak is locally known as Falchan Kangri in the Balti language.

q: The Supreme Court recently ruled that pellet guns
options: can only be used by the Army
may be used only in exceptional circumstances for crowd control
explanation: The Supreme Court declined to impose a blanket ban on pellet guns and held that they may be used only in exceptional circumstances for crowd control.

q: The petition regarding pellet guns was linked to protests over
explanation: The case followed allegations of pellet gun use against protesters demonstrating over the NEET-UG paper leak.

q: Which ministry extended the expert panel on the Western Ghats Ecologically Sensitive Area (ESA)?
options: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
explanation: The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEF&CC) extended the Sanjay Kumar-led expert panel by one year.

q: The committee examining the Western Ghats Ecologically Sensitive Area (ESA) issue is headed by
explanation: The expert panel examining the Western Ghats ESA issue is headed by Sanjay Kumar.

q: India's GST collections for July 2026 stood at
explanation: India recorded GST collections of ₹2.11 lakh crore in July 2026, reflecting strong domestic tax growth.

q: GST collections in July 2026 registered a year-on-year growth of
explanation: GST collections increased by 15.4% year-on-year in July 2026.

q: The Favara Instant Payment System belongs to which country?
explanation: Favara is the instant payment system developed by the Maldives Monetary Authority (MMA).

q: The Favara payment system has been integrated with India's
explanation: The Favara–UPI Cross-Border Payment Corridor integrates Maldives' Favara system with India's UPI.

q: The Favara–UPI Cross-Border Payment Corridor primarily enables
explanation: The corridor enables real-time cross-border remittances between the Maldives and India.

q: The Bay of Bengal is emerging as the geopolitical heart of India's
explanation: The Bay of Bengal has become central to India's eastern maritime strategy due to its strategic and economic significance.

q: Which of the following is NOT considered a non-traditional maritime security threat in the Bay of Bengal?
explanation: Climate change, cyber threats and supply-chain disruptions are non-traditional security threats, whereas conventional border fencing is not.

q: The Pradhan Mantri Surya Sarovar Yojana (PM-SSY) primarily promotes
explanation: PM-SSY promotes floating solar photovoltaic (FSPV) projects with battery storage on reservoirs and inland water bodies.

q: The Union Cabinet approved the Pradhan Mantri Surya Sarovar Yojana (PM-SSY) with an outlay of
explanation: The PM-SSY has been approved with a financial outlay of ₹5,070 crore.

q: The Pradhan Mantri Surya Sarovar Yojana (PM-SSY) aims to install how much Floating Solar Photovoltaic (FSPV) capacity?
explanation: The scheme envisages installing 5,000 MW of floating solar photovoltaic capacity across reservoirs and inland water bodies.

q: The revamped Khelo India Scheme approved by the Union Cabinet covers which period?
explanation: The revamped Khelo India Scheme will be implemented from 2026–27 to 2030–31.

q: The total financial outlay of the revamped Khelo India Scheme is
explanation: The Union Cabinet approved a total outlay of ₹36,441 crore for the revamped Khelo India Scheme, the largest investment in India's sports sector.

q: Tejaswin Shankar created history by becoming the first Indian to win a Commonwealth Games medal in which event?
explanation: Tejaswin Shankar became the first Indian to win a Commonwealth Games medal in the decathlon, securing a bronze medal with 7,976 points.
